label.description: The row's label, drawn muted in a fixed-width column.

kind.description: The built-in editor an activation opens. Leave it unset, with no `editor`, for a read-only row. A `toggle` row has no editor: activating it commits the opposite of `current`.

current.description: The value an editor starts from: the text of a `text`, `select` or `date` row, or the state of a `toggle`.

editLabel.description: The accessible name of the editor. Left unset, it reads "Edit" and the label.

disabled.description: Draws the row as read-only, even when it has an editor.

unsupportedProps.name: editor
unsupportedProps.description: A custom editor, shown in a popover anchored to the row's value. It wins over `kind`.

unsupportedProps.name: icon
unsupportedProps.description: An optional icon drawn before the label.

unsupportedProps.name: onCancel
unsupportedProps.description: Called when an edit is cancelled: with Escape, by activating the row again, or by dismissing the popover.

unsupportedProps.name: onCommit
unsupportedProps.description: Called when an edit is committed: with Enter, by leaving a field, by picking an option, by activating a toggle, or by a custom editor's `commit`.

unsupportedProps.name: value
unsupportedProps.description: The row's value, as it reads at rest.
